module.purpose: Implements a Murmur hash streaming algorithm with random seeds to resist hash-flooding attacks, providing a Hasher interface for incremental hashing of symbols, strings, numbers, and bigints.
module.summary: This file implements a MurmurHashStream class that provides incremental hashing for various JavaScript types. It uses random initial seeds and type markers to prevent hash collision attacks. The hasher maintains internal state (hash, length, carry buffer) and exposes update() and digest() methods. The implementation handles Unicode characters by writing both low and high bytes, and processes bigints in little-endian byte order. Random seeds are generated at module load time via randomHash().
module.businessContext: Provides secure hashing for the db-ivm in-memory virtual machine to prevent hash-flooding DoS attacks. Critical for hash-based data structures in the composites polyfill implementation.

units.name: _mix
units.source:
private _mix(k1: number): void {
    k1 = Math.imul(k1, 0xcc9e2d51)
    k1 = (k1 << 15) | (k1 >>> 17)
    k1 = Math.imul(k1, 0x1b873593)
    this.hash ^= k1
    this.hash = (this.hash << 13) | (this.hash >>> 19)
    this.hash = Math.imul(this.hash, 5) + 0xe6546b64
  }

detail.name: _mix
preconditions: k1 is a number representable as a signed 32-bit integer (Math.imul clamps to 32 bits)
postconditions: this.hash has been updated to incorporate the contribution of k1 through the MurmurHash3 mixing/folding operations
invariants: this.hash is always a 32-bit signed integer (all operations use Math.imul or bitwise ops that clamp to 32 bits)
edgeCases: k1 = 0: k1 contribution is 0 after fmix but this.hash still undergoes rotl(hash,13), imul(hash,5), and addition of 0xe6546b64
k1 = any 32-bit value: deterministic mix — same (this.hash, k1) always yields same result
stateMutations: this.hash — XORed, rotated, multiplied, and added to
detail.summary: Performs a single MurmurHash3 mixing step: transforms the input 32-bit word k1 through the standard fmix32 multiply-rotate-multiply sequence and folds the result into this.hash via XOR, rotate-left by 13, multiply by 5, and addition of the finalizer constant.
